rubrics.justification: Description is broadly consistent with a lower-stage blastocyst with good ICM and moderate TE, but it hedges between stage 2 and 3/4 and adds features like absence of degeneration/collapse that may not be confidently assessed from a single image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, oocyte yield, male factor context, endometrial thickness, BMI, lifestyle, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and structured, with prognosis tied to morphology and patient factors; minor issues include slight inconsistency about prior failed cycles and some overinterpretation of semen data context.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with IVF practice, including single embryo transfer and avoiding unsupported add-ons; minor deviations include speculative comments on embryo banking/PGT-A and fresh-cycle lining interpretation.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer management and contingency planning, though some suggestions remain somewhat general rather than highly case-specific.
